messages.subject: Duplicate-charge fix is live
messages.body:
Hey team — the idempotent webhook handler shipped to production yesterday evening. Before: every Stripe retry re-processed the payment and roughly 3 customers a day got double-charged. After 24h of monitoring: zero duplicate charges, and the two open customer complaints have been refunded and closed.

I'll keep the duplicate-charge alert on for the rest of the week, but I consider this done. Next time we touch webhooks we should reuse the same processed_events pattern.
